title: "Single-cell RNA-seq II: preparación para pseudobulk"
author: "Noemi Gomez"

output: html_document
---

```{r instalar_paquetes, eval=FALSE}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(c("muscData", "DESeq2", "clusterProfiler"))
install.packages("msigdbr")
```

```{r librerias}
library(Seurat)
library(muscData)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(DESeq2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(msigdbr)
```

```{r cargar_datos}
sce <- Kang18_8vs8()
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts(sce), meta.data = as.data.frame(colData(sce)),
                          project = "Kang_IFNb", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
```

```{r preparar_metadatos}
obj$donor_id <- as.character(obj$ind)
obj$condition <- toupper(as.character(obj$stim))
obj$cell_type <- as.character(obj$cell)
obj$sample_id <- paste(obj$donor_id, obj$condition, sep = "_")
```

```{r resumen_dataset}
cat("Células del dataset:", ncol(sce), "\nCélulas tras el filtro inicial:", ncol(obj),
    "\nPacientes en total:", n_distinct(obj$donor_id), "\n")
obj[[]] %>% distinct(donor_id, condition) %>% count(condition, name = "pacientes")
```

```{r generar_pseudobulk}
pseudo <- AggregateExpression(obj, assays = "RNA",
                              group.by = c("condition", "sample_id", "cell_type"),
                              return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA
dim(pseudo)
as.matrix(pseudo[1:10, 1:6])
```

```{r metadatos_pseudobulk}
meta_pb <- obj[[]] %>%
  count(condition, sample_id, cell_type, donor_id, name = "n_cells")
# Seurat reemplaza los guiones bajos dentro de cada etiqueta por guiones
rownames(meta_pb) <- with(meta_pb, paste(condition, gsub("_", "-", sample_id),
                                      gsub("_", "-", cell_type), sep = "_"))
meta_pb <- meta_pb[colnames(pseudo), ]
meta_pb$condition <- factor(meta_pb$condition, levels = c("CTRL", "STIM"))
head(meta_pb)
```

```{r seleccionar_monocitos}
# Conservar perfiles de monocitos CD14+ con al menos 20 células
coldata <- subset(meta_pb, cell_type == "CD14+ Monocytes" & n_cells >= 20,
                  select = c(donor_id, condition, sample_id, n_cells))
coldata$donor_id <- factor(coldata$donor_id)
counts_mono <- as.matrix(pseudo[, rownames(coldata), drop = FALSE])
dim(counts_mono)
table(coldata$donor_id, coldata$condition)
```

```{r preparar_deseq2}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_mono, colData = coldata,
                              design = ~ donor_id + condition)
# Conservar genes con al menos 10 conteos en 3 o más perfiles
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "STIM", "CTRL"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(res)
```

```{r preparar_volcano}
# Contraste STIM / CTRL: log2FC positivo indica mayor expresión en STIM
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(grupo = case_when(
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 2 ~ "Mayor en STIM",
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -2 ~ "Mayor en CTRL",
    TRUE ~ "No significativo"
  ))
table(res_df$grupo)
genes_sig <- filter(res_df, grupo != "No significativo")
head(genes_sig[order(genes_sig$padj), c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj", "grupo")])
```

```{r volcano, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
ggplot(res_df, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)), color = grupo)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Mayor en CTRL" = "#377EB8",
                                "Mayor en STIM" = "#E41A1C",
                                "No significativo" = "grey75")) +
  labs(x = "log2FC (STIM / CTRL)", y = "-log10(p ajustado)", color = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r referencia_gobp}
go_bp <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C5", subcollection = "GO:BP") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r enriquecimiento_gobp}
genes <- split(genes_sig$gene, genes_sig$grupo)
enriq <- compareCluster(
  geneClusters = genes,
  fun = "enricher",
  TERM2GENE = go_bp,
  universe = res_df$gene,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)
```

```{r dotplot_gobp, fig.width=16, fig.height=8}
enrichplot::dotplot(enriq, showCategory = 5) + labs(x = NULL, title = "Enriquecimiento GO:BP")
```
